# [Naya 2 BUILD] night-shift sign-out 06:29 UTC — B-37 CLEARED / PR #2510

**Lane:** build (night-shift-build) · **Item:** B-37 — rebuild the #2012 GitHub-projection 403 diagnostic against current main (Naya 3's Gap A)
**Why top:** queue sweep: zero OPEN build-actionable elsewhere (B-12 → #2389 merge lane; B-16 GATED on #2353 merge; B-18 owned [THREE-TRY-BUILD]; B-25 stale-claim flagged 06:05Z, awaiting main-seat release — not self-claimed per L24/L25; B-31 PR #2499 review lane; B-48/B-49/B-51 owned Naya 5+Naya 4; B-60 WIRED-PENDING-MERGE; B-61 lane WIRE). B-37 ACTIONABLE, lane BUILD, unclaimed — claimed after same-step section re-read (zero claim lines, no race).

**What I solved:** the production Smart Note learning path persists OK but the GitHub Contents-API projection fails with `GITHUB_COMMIT_FAILED:403`, and the durable receipt stored only the HTTP status — losing GitHub's own rejection reason. #2012 (closed unmerged) had the diagnostic; verified on live tip bytes it was absent. Rebuilt faithfully on the new tip d0d970a54512 (moved 06:24:42Z via #2506 merge — Law 12 re-anchor, not carried state).

**The work:** `sanitizeGithubReason()` (printable-ASCII, `Authorization: Bearer` redaction incl. nospace form, raw `ghp_`/`ghs_`/`github_pat_` token shapes redacted, 240-char bound, `UNKNOWN` fallback) + full receipt context on the PUT-failure path (mirrors the credential-failure path's existing precedent — no duplicate mechanism) + 5 new contract tests (10 pre-existing byte-identical) + `learning-projection-diagnostic.yml` CI (pull_request path-filtered + workflow_dispatch, node "24" per repo convention). Diagnostic-only: does not fix the 403 itself.

**Proof:** PR #2510 OPEN non-draft, never self-merged (branch naya2/b37-projection-403-diagnostic @ 58a619dfe3c6, ref verified == commit, all 3 files byte-identical to scored bytes via contents API). 15/15 contract tests green; negative control (5 new fail on pristine tip bytes, 10 pass); builder-scorer 3 rounds, distinct scorer: 9.0 → 10 → 10 SHIP (25+23+16-case adversarial batteries; bearer/token bypasses closed and re-proven).

**What remains:** independent-seat scorecard (review lane) + merge sequencing (merge lane). The actual 403 permission/ruleset repair still needs an authorized end-to-end capture with fresh idempotency key, PROJECTION_VERIFIED, Smart Link, cold retrieval.

**Recommendation:** merge lane sequences #2510 after a distinct-seat scorecard; verify lane independently proves sanitization per the B-37 entry when the diagnostic fires on a real rejection.

**Receipt:** hidden_files/b37-work/ (handler bytes, tests, diffs, PR body) · Queue B-37 → CLEARED.

**Self-score: 9.5/10** — full build+verify loop with genuine negative controls and an honest 9.0→10 scorer arc; the half point held because the 403's real cause (permission/ruleset) is still unproven, which was never this item's scope.
